Você cuidará da imagem do ponto de venda, mantendo a organização e a apresentação dos produtos de acordo com o padrão de luxo da L'Oréal. Em parceria com a equipe da loja, você irá colaborar para atingir metas e compartilhará informações valiosas sobre as vendas para o time. Buscamos uma pessoa com potencial de crescimento, alinhada aos valores da L'Oréal e com um forte espírito empreendedor. Você se encaixa perfeitamente se tiver: Foco no Cliente: Paixão por entender e superar as expectativas dos consumidores. Orientação para Resultados: Energia para alcançar e exceder metas de vendas. Comunicação de Impacto: Habilidade para se conectar de forma clara e cativante. Agilidade e Resiliência: Capacidade de se adaptar e aprender em um ambiente dinâmico. Espírito Colaborativo: Gosta de trabalhar em equipe para alcançar o sucesso coletivo. O que Oferecemos a Você Um ambiente que inspira seu desenvolvimento: Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de explorar novos desafios e expandir seu potencial, com todo o incentivo para aprender e inovar. A chance de causar um impacto real desde o início: Na L'Oréal, sua contribuição é valorizada e você participa ativamente dos projetos desde o primeiro dia. Um lugar onde a diversidade é celebrada: Criamos um ambiente onde pessoas de todas as etnias, origens sociais, idades, religiões, gêneros e orientações sexuais, assim como pessoas com deficiência, são acolhidas e encorajadas a prosperar. A oportunidade de contribuir para um propósito maior: Muitas de nossas marcas têm causas socioambientais que fazem a diferença no mundo, e você fará parte disso. Junte-se a nós na L'Oréal, a empresa de beleza número 1 do mundo, presente em mais de 150 mercados. Há mais de um século, estamos em constante transformação, impulsionados por dados, tecnologia, inovação e ciência. Juntos, enfrentamos grandes desafios enquanto nos mantemos comprometidos em tornar o mundo um lugar mais inclusivo e melhor para todos e para o nosso planeta. Na L'Oréal Luxe, nossa missão é criar o melhor da beleza de luxo. Através de um portfólio de 25 marcas aspiracionais e complementares, expressamos uma visão única de luxo: La Culture de l'Écart. Temos o compromisso de garantir processos de recrutamento inclusivos e de defender a contratação e a promoção de cada candidato(a) de forma ética e equitativa. O Grupo proíbe estritamente a discriminação contra qualquer candidato(a) a emprego devido à sua identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, deficiências visíveis e/ou invisíveis, origens socioeconômicas e/ou multiculturais, condições de saúde, idade, religião ou quaisquer outras características protegidas por lei. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra, determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível. Foco no cliente: Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes. Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos. Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre. Sobre a Oportunidade Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance? Conheça o XP Future , uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos. Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro. Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora, e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado! Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar no XP Future logo abaixo! Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios); Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos; Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira; Conhecimento básico sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros). Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc); Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI). Diferenciais: Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros); CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro). Desafios e Impacto Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes; Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes; Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades; Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico; Disciplina para manter uma alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial. Obs.: a contratação é CLT. Essa vaga é destinada a um pool de rede de talentos a nível Brasil, então pode ser que o retorno demore um pouco a mais do que outras vagas da XP! Em paralelo, também estão abertas as vagas dos XDays XP Future (vagas que acontecerão processos seletivos presenciais na cidade divulgada) para você se aplicar! Candidatar a esta vaga indica um campo obrigatório Tipos de arquivos aceitos: pdf, doc, docx, txt, rtf Por fim, abaixo segue o vídeo sobre o Fator XP! Para você se reconhecer cada vez mais no nosso propósito como empresa e cultura: Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass, Zenklub, VA, VR, New Value, seguro de vida. Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias. Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos. Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. #J-18808-Ljbffr

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes. Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país. E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras. Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS:* Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos; DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES: Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Ai development orchestrator
description:
Empresa está contratando Ai development orchestrator em campo grande. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Location: Remote Type: Full-Time Reports to: CEO Stack: Type Script, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, Postgre SQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating Saa S, active production users Start: Immediate The Company Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2 B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15 M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale. The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable. What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\" Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2 E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites. Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author. Supabase in production. Postgre SQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. Type Script primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, Hub Spot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role. Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or Web Sockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product Saa S background, not agency or consultancy. Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications. Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward Type Script + Supabase (or equivalent Postgre SQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving. How We Evaluate No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty. What We Offer A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15 M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI; quality comes from you. To Apply or Refer Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + Type Script + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

Ships high‐quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence. Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform. Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement. Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices. AWS native Architecture Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, Dynamo DB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more. Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‐optimized. Systems Integration Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‐specific tools. Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions. AI Forward Development Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‐powered workflows into the product. Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks. Identify opportunities to expand AI‐driven automation across the platform. Collaboration & Impact Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs. Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning. Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows. What We Are Looking For 8+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong expertise in Node.js, Type Script, React, and AWS cloud architecture. Experience building distributed systems, event‐driven architectures, or workflow automation. Comfortable working across the stack (backend‐heavy, but able to contribute to frontend). Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‐technical teams. High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‐moving, ambiguous environments. Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‐to‐day work. Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems. Why Freight Hero Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2 B tech. Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes. Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales. Competitive compensation with performance incentives. Fully remote with a collaborative, high‐performance culture.

You'll support current clients, client data, retreat prep, onboarding, internal systems, pipeline tracking, and podcast scheduling. The work is detailed, important, and very real. If you like being the person who knows where things stand, what's missing, and what needs to happen next, this may be a great fit. What You'll Own ----------- Client Services Operations This is the center of the role. You'll help keep current client work moving cleanly: data workflows, dashboards, retreat materials, onboarding, Hub Spot notes, scheduling details, internal reports, recordings, client folders, and recurring team systems. You'll also help catch what's slipping before it becomes a problem: missing data, unclear ownership, stalled tasks, unlogged client context, messy files, late follow-ups, or anything that makes Client Services feel less prepared. The goal is simple: current clients feel cared for, Client Services feels supported, and the team trusts that the operational details are handled. Pipeline + Relationship Tracking You'll help us track important non-client relationships: incoming leads, meetings, deals, contracts, key dates, next steps, and handoffs. You won't be the salesperson or the primary external email owner. You'll keep the system accurate so the right person can follow through well and Client Services can provide a high-touch experience before someone becomes a client. Podcast Scheduling + Production Coordination You'll help keep our podcast schedule realistic and ahead of the calendar. That means protecting planning time, suggesting recording days that match the production schedule, tracking key dates, and flagging when we need to record multiple episodes ahead because the business calendar is getting full. You won't own content, writing, editing, or creative direction. This is schedule, process, and timeline management. This Role Is a Fit If You: • Notice gaps and communicate them early • Take ownership without needing to be chased • Track details carefully and follow through completely • Ask smart questions, then remember the answer • Can support a busy team without adding noise • Stay calm when priorities shift • Take pride in being reliable, thorough, and useful This Role Is Not a Fit If You: • Need detailed instructions for every task • Wait to be told what to do next • See problems but don't speak up • Think "done" means "mostly handled" • Struggle when a process is not perfectly documented Requirements • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills • Clear written and verbal English • High ownership and follow-through • Strong attention to detail • Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities • Experience with calendars, spreadsheets, CRMs, project management tools, and modern Saa S systems • Fast, stable internet connection • Professional presence on video Tools may include Click Up, Hub Spot, Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, Loom, Fireflies, reporting dashboards, spreadsheets, and podcast scheduling tools. Work Setup Remote, Latin America preferred Contractor, 40 hours/week with meaningful overlap with U. S. business hours Compensation: $1000/mo USD (you will invoce your hours) How to Apply We care about experience, but we care more about ownership, judgment, communication, and follow-through. You'll submit: • Your resume • A short video introducing yourself and telling us why this role speaks to you • Anything else that helps us understand how you think and work We will follow up with a shortlist of prospects and request a Sample Project submission that will demonstrate aspects of the work you'll be doing, and we will compensate you for the time that takes. We're looking for someone who wants to become a real operational partner to the team, not just complete assigned tasks. If you're the kind of person who sees the gap, owns the follow-through, and makes the whole team feel more organized, we want to meet you.

title: Senior java developer
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior java developer em campo grande. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

A VMetrix é uma plataforma Saa S que atende instituições financeiras na América Latina. Processamos fluxos transacionais complexos, pipelines de dados de alto volume e integrações em tempo real — tudo construído sobre uma stack Java/Spring Boot + Oracle implantada na Oracle Cloud. Buscamos desenvolvedores Java sólidos que escrevam código excelente, pensem em sistemas e adotem o desenvolvimento assistido por IA como parte central do seu fluxo de trabalho. Propósito do Cargo Como Senior Java Developer, você vai construir e manter serviços backend e módulos de plataforma que suportam operações críticas de negócio. Você não precisa de experiência prévia no domínio financeiro — nós ensinamos. O que precisamos é de um desenvolvedor que escreva Java limpo e performante, domine padrões de design, entenda sistemas distribuídos e use ferramentas como Claude Code para se mover rápido sem sacrificar qualidade. Responsabilidades Principais: Desenvolvimento Backend Projetar, construir e manter serviços backend em Java 8+/Spring Boot: APIs REST, jobs de processamento batch, pipelines de transformação de dados e camadas de integração. Escrever código limpo, bem testado e pronto para produção, aplicando princípios SOLID, padrões de design (Strategy, Factory, Observer, Builder, Template Method, entre outros) e as diretrizes arquiteturais da equipe. Ser dono de features end-to-end: desde o design técnico até a implementação, testes, code review e deploy em produção. Otimizar o desempenho de aplicações: identificar e resolver gargalos em queries, chamadas a serviços, uso de memória e throughput. Aplicar corretamente padrões de concorrência e gerenciamento de threads em Java para operações paralelas e assíncronas. Design e Arquitetura Participar de decisões de design de software: seleção de padrões, definição de contratos entre componentes, separação de responsabilidades e modelagem de domínios. Aplicar princípios de design orientado a objetos (encapsulamento, herança, composição, polimorfismo) e design por contrato na construção de módulos. Contribuir para o design de arquiteturas limpas: separação de camadas (controller, service, repository), injeção de dependências, inversão de controle e baixo acoplamento entre módulos. Avaliar trade-offs técnicos entre diferentes abordagens de design, documentando decisões e suas justificativas. Banco de Dados e Integrações Trabalhar com Oracle Database: escrever e otimizar consultas SQL, stored procedures e packages PL/SQL para operações intensivas em dados. Construir e manter integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST, cobrindo ingestão, transformação e sincronização de dados. Projetar padrões de acesso a dados eficientes usando JPA/Hibernate ou JDBC, com atenção a gerenciamento de conexões, cache de entidades e limites transacionais. Implementar estratégias de resiliência em integrações: retentativas, circuit breakers, timeouts e tratamento gracioso de falhas. Infraestrutura e Deploy Implantar e gerenciar aplicações em Kubernetes (OKE) com contêineres Docker e servidor de aplicações Web Logic. Trabalhar com pipelines CI/CD (Git Lab CI ou similar) para fluxos automatizados de build, teste e deployment. Diagnosticar problemas em produção: analisar logs, métricas de aplicação e comportamento do sistema para resolver incidentes. Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA Usar Claude Code como ferramenta principal de desenvolvimento: geração de código, refatoração, debugging, escrita de testes e exploração de codebases desconhecidos. Escrever e manter documentação técnica em Markdown que sirva como contexto de alta qualidade tanto para ferramentas de IA quanto para a equipe. Aplicar habilidades de engenharia de prompts: decompor problemas complexos em prompts claros e acionáveis, avaliando criticamente as saídas geradas por IA. Contribuir para as práticas de desenvolvimento com IA da equipe: compartilhar padrões eficazes, identificar limitações e ajudar a estabelecer melhores práticas. Colaboração e Crescimento Participar de revisões de código com feedback construtivo e rigoroso, focado em corretude, legibilidade, padrões e manutenibilidade. Mentorar desenvolvedores junior através de pair programming, discussões de design e transferência de conhecimento. Contribuir para discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura, ferramentas e melhorias de processos. Requisitos Obrigatórios: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas. 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento Java. Domínio sólido de Java 8+ (streams, lambdas, concorrência, collections, Optional, API de data/hora) e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, segurança, Spring Data, testes). Conhecimento sólido de padrões de design Go F (criacionais, estruturais, comportamentais) e capacidade de aplicá-los corretamente conforme o contexto do problema. Domínio dos princípios SOLID, DRY, KISS e YAGNI na prática diária de desenvolvimento. Experiência com design orientado a objetos: modelagem de domínios, composição vs herança, encapsulamento, tratamento de exceções e design de APIs internas claras. Habilidades sólidas em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais: otimização de queries, estratégias de indexação, joins complexos, gerenciamento transacional. Experiência com Oracle é um diferencial forte. Experiência com estratégias de testes: testes unitários (JUnit, Mockito), testes de integração, test doubles e TDD ou BDD como prática habitual. Experiência com deploys em contêineres: Docker, Kubernetes (qualquer distribuição), pipelines CI/CD. Familiaridade com fluxos Git (Git Flow ou trunk-based), Postman/Open API para desenvolvimento de APIs. Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA — especialmente Claude Code. Esperamos que você use IA diariamente como multiplicador de produtividade, não como muleta. Comunicação escrita sólida: capacidade de produzir specs técnicos claros, documentos de design e descrições de PR. Requisitos Desejáveis: Experiência com Oracle PL/SQL: stored procedures, pipelined functions, performance tuning. Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura: caching (Caffeine/Redis), arquitetura event-driven, design metadata-driven, CQRS. Experiência com arquiteturas de microsserviços ou modular monolith: estratégias de comunicação entre serviços, gerenciamento de transações distribuídas, contract testing. Familiaridade com Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture ou Domain-Driven Design (DDD). Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade: Grafana, Prometheus, métricas de aplicação, agregação de logs. Familiaridade com servidor de aplicações Web Logic ou runtimes Java empresariais similares. Experiência trabalhando em plataformas Saa S ou sistemas multi-tenant. Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações técnicas equivalentes. O Que Valorizamos: Qualidade acima de velocidade: preferimos entregar código limpo e bem testado um dia depois do que debugar um desastre por uma semana. Fluência com IA: você vê Claude Code e ferramentas similares como partes essenciais do seu toolkit, não como novidades. Sabe quando confiar no output e quando questioná-lo. Critério de design: você não aplica padrões por inércia — sabe quando um Strategy simplifica e quando um if-else é suficiente. Prioriza clareza acima de cleverness. Pensamento sistêmico: considera os efeitos downstream das suas decisões de design em desempenho, manutenibilidade e velocidade da equipe. title: Applied ai engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Applied ai engineer em campo grande. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Applied AI Engineer Who We AreEnlightened Today is a rapidly expanding and innovative company leading the charge in the spiritual and wellness space. We are dedicated to changing the industry with bold, creative marketing strategies and forward-thinking technical solutions. Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, and crafting content that deeply resonates with our audience. Our business model centers on creating authentic connections with our audience through digital channels and delivering premium services and products that meet their needs. The role This is a hands-on, embedded engineering role. Instead of sitting behind a backlog and building to spec, you'll embed directly with the founders and the team, figure out what the business actually needs (which is often not what was first asked for), and ship working AI solutions fast. You'll move fluidly between building AI agents, shipping customer-facing AI products, and wiring up the data that feeds both, talking to the people who'll use what you build, iterating in front of them, and turning rough ideas into things that work. In short: part engineer, part solutions architect, part builder-who-talks-to-humans. You'll be deployed against our own business and customers rather than external clients, but the instincts are the same: high autonomy, fast prototyping, strong communication, and a bias toward shipping something useful over perfecting something slowly. This is a \"hire for talent\" role, and we care far more about what you can build and how you think than about your years of experience or pedigree. If you're early-career but exceptional, or senior and want to get your hands dirty again, both are welcome. What you'll build You'll lead or contribute to three flagship initiatives: Agentic orchestration. We run our development and operations on an internal system of specialized AI agents, built on Claude Code, that plan, build, and review each other's work before anything ships, with reusable skills and adversarial review gates that keep quality high. You'll operate it, extend it, build new agents and skills for our specific workflows, and keep those quality gates sharp. Conversational AI grounded in the customer. Build AI chat and voice experiences that tap into a customer's profile and behavioral signals to have genuinely helpful, personalized conversations with them about their relationship and life questions, the core of what our customers come to us for. This spans retrieval over customer profiles, conversation memory, and (on the roadmap) real-time voice. Signal-based personalized marketing. Turn customer signals into tailored marketing: segments, scoring, and personalized messaging pushed through our marketing stack. This extends our existing lead-intelligence pipeline. You won't do all three every week, but over a quarter you'll likely touch all of them. Our stack AI / LLM: Claude (API + Claude Code), multi-agent orchestration, prompt and skill authoring, Eleven Labs for voice Primary language: Python Backend / data: Postgres / Supabase (incl. pgvector), REST APIs Frontend: Next.js, React, Vercel, HTML/CSS Marketing infra: Klaviyo, Checkout Champ, Hyros, attribution and CRM tools Tooling: Git/Git Hub, CI, modern AI-assisted dev workflows (some of our agent tooling touches shell + Type Script/Node) You don't need every item on this list. You do need to be the kind of person who picks up a new tool quickly and ships with it. What we're looking for Hands-on, embedded instincts: you can sit with a non-technical stakeholder, diagnose what they actually need, and turn it into something working, fast, and without a detailed spec Strong communication: you'll work directly with the founders and explain your work to non-engineers clearly Strong Python and solid full-stack fundamentals, comfortable across backend logic, data, and a functional frontend Real, hands-on LLM experience: prompting, retrieval (RAG), chaining, evaluating outputs, and handling the messy reality of non-deterministic systems Agentic experience: you've built or seriously operated multi-agent systems and understand orchestration, tool/function calling, and review/eval loops Fluency with AI-assisted development: you use tools like Claude Code daily and know how to get great output from them Solid engineering discipline: testing (we value TDD), clean Git workflows, and the judgment to build quality gates rather than skip them Comfortable in shell and Type Script/Node when the tooling calls for it, and you don't have to be an expert, but you can't be allergic to it A bias toward shipping: working software over perfect software Sound judgment around sensitive, emotional conversations. Our customers come to us about love and relationships; AI that talks with them needs guardrails, scope limits, escalation paths, and clear boundaries built in. We treat this as a design requirement, not an afterthought Care with personal data: customer profiles and conversation content are sensitive (consent, data minimization, secure storage, CCPA) Nice to have Prior solutions-engineering, founder, or consulting experience, or anything that put you face-to-face with the people you build for Experience with conversational/voice AI: TTS/STT, low-latency streaming, voice-agent frameworks (Live Kit, Pipecat, Vapi) Experience in DTC e-commerce, subscriptions, or performance marketing Familiarity with attribution/CRM platforms and marketing APIs Recommendation, personalization, or feature-store experience Familiarity with agentic frameworks (Lang Graph, Crew AI, Auto Gen, or similar) and the Agent Skills pattern A portfolio of shipped products, repos, demos, or AI projects we can look at Why this role is different Genuine ownership. Direct access to the founders, no layers of approval, and the ability to ship to real customers fast. You're close to the problem. You won't be handed tickets in isolation. You'll sit with the business, see the real need, and build for it directly. AI-native by default. You'll orchestrate AI agents rather than type every line, the way the best engineers will work in a few years. Breadth. If you're tired of being a cog on one narrow feature, this is the opposite. You'll touch the whole business. How to applyRecord a 3-minute video introducing yourself along with your resume to Tell us why you're excited about this role, and a few things we should know about you, professionally and personally.

title: Direct-response ad video editor
description:
Empresa está contratando Direct-response ad video editor em campo grande. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

We're looking for a direct response video editor who can produce 1-3 performance ads per day — consistently, quickly, and without hand-holding. You'll receive reference ads, raw footage, AI-generated visuals, voiceover audio, product photography, UGC clips, and creative briefs. Your job is to turn those inputs into scroll-stopping Meta ads that look native to the feed, follow direct response principles, and are ready to launch same-day. Some days you'll get a detailed brief with every asset handed to you. Other days you'll get a reference ad and a direction — and you'll need to reverse-engineer the structure, build a visual concept, and deliver a finished ad using your own creative instincts. This is not a 9-to-5 editing job. This is a performance marketing role that happens to live inside an editing timeline. What You'll Be Doing Editing 1-3 short-form video ads per day (15-60 seconds) for Meta placements Working with a mix of UGC footage, AI-generated imagery, 3 D medical-style animations, product photography, voiceover tracks, and b-roll Receiving reference ads and reverse-engineering their pacing, structure, visual rhythm, and caption systems to build Velor Health versions Building ads from creative briefs that include scripts, shot lists, visual direction, and caption specs Originating new ad concepts when given only a direction or angle — proposing visual treatments, caption styles, and pacing without being told exactly what to do Implementing caption systems with color-coded text (white/red/blue pill captions, green keyword highlights, auto-generated Tik Tok-style captions) depending on the ad format Cutting multiple versions of the same ad (hook variants, length variants, aspect ratio variants) for A/B testing Maintaining a fast turnaround — most ads should go from brief to finished export within 2-4 hours Organizing and managing a growing library of raw assets, finished ads, and creative templates What You Need Proven experience editing direct response or performance marketing video ads (not brand content, not music videos, not wedding films — direct response ads that ran on Meta or Tik Tok with measurable results) Fluency in Cap Cut, Premiere Pro, or After Effects — whichever you're fastest in Strong understanding of Meta ad formats — you know what a native feed ad looks like versus a produced commercial, and you default to native Ability to match reference ad pacing intuitively — if we send you a competitor ad, you can deconstruct its cut timing, caption rhythm, and visual structure without being taught Comfort working with AI-generated imagery and integrating it seamlessly into live footage and product photography Experience with caption styling — you've built caption systems before (color-coded, keyword-highlighted, timed to VO) and you understand that captions are a conversion tool, not an accessibility afterthought A sharp eye for thumbnail-level scroll-stopping — you understand that the first frame of a video ad is a static image in the feed and you treat it accordingly Ability to self-manage, meet daily output targets, and communicate proactively when something is unclear or delayed Reliable internet connection and availability during US business hours (ET or CT preferred but flexible for the right person) Bonus (Not Required) Experience editing ads in the health, wellness, fitness, or DTC supplement space Familiarity with the \"ugly ad\" aesthetic — ads intentionally designed to look like organic UGC rather than polished production Experience with motion graphics or basic After Effects animation (for text overlays, simple transitions, or kinetic typography) Understanding of direct response copywriting principles (you know why a hook matters, why the product should appear early, why the CTA needs to sound like a peer recommendation) What You Don't Need A film degree A fancy reel of cinematic work Experience at a big agency Color grading expertise We care about speed, instinct, and output quality at volume. If your best work is a single beautifully-graded 3-minute brand film, this isn't the right fit. If your best work is 47 Meta ads you cut last month that all drove profitable ROAS, we want to talk to you. Compensation Competitive rate based on experience. This is a contract role with potential to grow into a long-term position as the brand scales. We value speed and consistency — editors who hit daily output targets reliably will have no shortage of work. How To Apply There will be a paid test before any hire is made. Here's how it works: Apply with your portfolio. Send 3-5 examples of direct response video ads you've edited that actually ran on Meta or Tik Tok. Tell us the niche, the objective, and the result if you have it. We don't need a sizzle reel — we need proof you've done this before. If your portfolio fits, we'll send you a paid test project. You'll receive a reference ad, a script, raw assets (footage, images, voiceover), and a creative brief. You'll have 24 hours to deliver a finished ad. This test is paid regardless of whether you're hired. We evaluate the test on four criteria: Did you match the pacing and structure of the reference? Did the first frame stop the scroll? Did the captions and visual rhythm support the VO? Did you deliver on time? If the test passes, you start with a one-week trial at 1 ad per day. If that week goes well, we scale to full output. We're not looking for perfection. We're looking for someone who ships fast, learns from references quickly, and gets better with every ad they cut. To apply, send your portfolio and a brief note about your direct response editing experience to (your email) with the subject line \"DR Editor — (Your Name).\"

description:

Company Description: Million Logics is a trusted Oracle Partner and global leader in IT solutions, with operations in London, UK, and a development hub in Hyderabad, India. Specialising in innovative and scalable services, Million Logics empowers enterprises through data & AI, cloud solutions, IT consulting, and custom application development. With a team of 85+ AI/ML experts, we deliver tailored solutions that foster digital transformation and operational excellence. We are committed to client success. We blend world-class technical expertise with strategic insight to deliver results. Role Overview: As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and You Tube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions such as Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness. Offer Details: Duration of Contract: 6 months Pay: $1500 per month (net/take-home) Mode of work: Fully Remote Number of Positions: 20 Must have fluency in Portgutal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese ) Skills: Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field). Key Qualifications: Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portgutal Portuguese (not Brazilian Portuguese ) with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project. Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (Sx S) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and over-narrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Description: In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied. Analysing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"over-narrating\". Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (Sx S) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history. Education & Experience: BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. Additional Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor Engagement Length: 6 months
